$comment: Execution-environment registry for setup detection (alpha.48 I-S2; INIT ANALYSIS §11(b)/(c)7). Order is preference order. `support: unsupported` entries are only reported as present, never probed further. Read-only argv only: version, context inspect, info. Markers are data: `desktop.operatingSystem` is the `docker info` OperatingSystem value Docker Desktop reports and `desktop.cliPrefixes` the WSL integration's CLI location (observed convention, not a documented contract; checked 2026-10-19); `rootless.securityOptions` follows the Engine API (GET /info SecurityOptions contains name=rootless; docs.docker.com engine/security/rootless, checked 2026-10-19).
